text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The time for the decisive battle has 
finally arrived. Aiming to bring "A New 
Glory for the Mejiros," Mejiro Dober 
stands to face Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Mejiro Dober asked if I believed in 
her strength, I sent her off with the same 
unwavering trust I've had in her since the 
day we met.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Witness it. The moment Mejiro Dober 
becomes "Mejiro Dober" and takes flight 
toward new glory...!
